rubric.criterion: The workflow first confirms that IncidentLifecycle is the canonical state and transition owner.
The system stage returns DESCEND with the lifecycle invariants as a compact handoff.
Only then does the simplicity stage identify IncidentFacade as a one-use forwarding module that can be deleted.
The recommendation preserves idempotency, recovery, and durable outbox intent through the IncidentLifecycle interface.
The two stages run sequentially and the simplicity reviewer receives only the accepted leaf scope and invariants.
